podcast.body: Co-written with guitarist Todd Sharp, this solo single cracked the top 40 in the winter of 1984 and ultimately reached number 10 in March, marking Christine McVie's first and only top 10 solo hit. "Co-written with guitarist Todd Sharp, McVee's got a hold on me. Cracked the top 40 in the winter of 1984, and Casey Kassum offered some deep Fleetwood Mac trivia."

srcs.source: Hit Parade Music History and Music Trivia
